en.title: Why VPI needs surgery and speech therapy

sentences.text: When you speak, a muscle lifts the soft palate against the back of the throat.
After a cleft palate repair, the soft palate can be too short to reach.
Air leaks into the nose, and speech sounds nasal.
Practice cannot close this gap. It needs surgery.
Here, a strip of tissue from the throat is joined to the soft palate.
A speech pathologist checks speech before and after surgery, and treats sounds learned the wrong way.
